sqlMap.sql:
( SELECT T.DEPTNO
FROM (SELECT OI.*, ORI.CHANGE_DATE FROM ORG_INFO OI, ORG_RESUME_INFO ORI
WHERE OI.RESUME_NO = ORI.NO AND OI.RESUME_NO = pkg_resume_process.GET_HISTORY_RESUME_NO(#interCpnyID#,#YEARMONTHDAY#) AND OI.ACTIVITY='1'
) T WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID#
START WITH T.PARENT_DEPT_NO = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR T.DEPTNO = T.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
sqlMap.select:
SELECT HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HE.CHINESE_PINYIN, HE.PERSON_ID, HE.DEPTNO, HE.DUTY_NO, HE.POST_GRADE_NO, HE.POSITION_NO, get_dept_name(HE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPARTMENT, to_char(HE.DATE_STARTED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_LEFT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DATE_LEFT, HE.STATUS_CODE, get_global_name(HE.STATUS_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) STATUS_NAME, HE.EMP_TYPE_CODE, get_global_name(HE.EMP_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) EMP_TYPE_NAME, HE.EMP_OFFICE, get_global_name(HE.EMP_OFFICE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) EMP_OFFICE_NAME, HP.IDCARD_NO, HP.SEXCODE, get_global_name(HP.SEXCODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SEX, HP.NATIONALITY_CODE, get_global_name(HP.NATIONALITY_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) NATIONALITY, HP.INSURANCE_TYPE_CODE, get_global_name(HP.INSURANCE_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) INSURANCE_TYPE, HP.PASSPORT_NO, HP.FOREIGNER_IDCARD_NO, HPI.BANK_ID, HPI.CARD_NO, HPI.CALC_FLAG, HPI.IS_CALC_FLAG FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_PERSONAL_INFO HP, HR_EMP_PA_INFO HPI WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = HP.PERSON_ID(+) AND HE.PERSON_ID = HPI.PERSON_ID(+) AND HE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
HE.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT HE.LOCAL_NAME, HE.EMPID, get_dept_name(HE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPT_NAME, get_global_name(HE.POSITION, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POSITION, get_global_name(HE.DUTY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY_NO, get_global_name(HE.POST_FAMILY, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_FAMILY, get_global_name(HE.POST_GRADE_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_GRADE_NO FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE HE.PERSON_ID=#PERSON_ID#

SELECT AR_MONTH, SUBSTR(AR_MONTH, 0, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(AR_MONTH, 5, 2) AR_MONTH_STR FROM (SELECT DISTINCT AR_MONTH FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(APPLY_OT_DATE, 'YYYYMM') AR_MONTH FROM ESS_APPLY_OT SS WHERE PERSON_ID IN (SELECT PERSON_ID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') AR_MONTH FROM DUAL) TT ORDER BY AR_MONTH) SS ORDER BY AR_MONTH

SELECT HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HE.PERSON_ID, HE.DEPTNO, get_global_name(HE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPARTMENT, ESS.APPLY_NO, TO_CHAR(ESS.APPLY_OT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') APPLY_OT_DATE, ESS.OT_TYPE_CODE, get_global_name(ESS.OT_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) OT_TYPE_NAME, nvl(ESS.OT_APPLY_HOUR,0) OT_APPLY_HOUR, nvl(ESS.OT_APPLY_MINUTE,0) OT_APPLY_MINUTE, substr(ESS.APPLY_OT_REMARK,0,8) APPLY_OT_REMARK, ESS.APPLY_OT_REMARK APPLY_REMARK, ESS.CURRENT_AFFIRM_ID, ESS.ACTIVITY, ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, ESS_APPLY_OT ESS WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = ESS.PERSON_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, ESS_APPLY_OT ESS WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = ESS.PERSON_ID

SELECT HE.EMPID, HE.PERSON_ID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HE.DUTY_NO, get_global_name(HE.DUTY_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY_NAME, HE.DEPTNO DEPT_NO, HE.POSITION_NO, HE.POST_NO, HE.POST_GRADE_NO, HE.CPNY_ID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT TB.AFFIRMOR_ID, TB.AFFIRM_LEVEL, HR_AFFIRMOR.EMPID, HR_AFFIRMOR.LOCAL_NAME, HR_AFFIRMOR.DUTY_NO, SG.CONTENT DUTY_NAME FROM SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_TB TB, HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_EMPLOYEE HR_AFFIRMOR, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE TB.AFFIRM_OBJECT = HE.PERSON_ID AND TB.AFFIRMOR_ID = HR_AFFIRMOR.PERSON_ID AND HR_AFFIRMOR.DUTY_NO = SG.NO(+) AND TB.AFFIRM_TYPE_ID = #APPLY_TYPE_NO:VARCHAR# AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND TB.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# ORDER BY TB.AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT TB.AFFIRMOR_ID, HR_AFFIRMOR.LOCAL_NAME, HR_AFFIRMOR.EMPID, TB.AFFIRM_LEVEL, HR_AFFIRMOR.DUTY_NO, SG.CONTENT DUTY_NAME FROM SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_TB TB, HR_DEPARTMENT D, HR_EMPLOYEE HR_AFFIRMOR, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE TB.AFFIRM_OBJECT = D.DEPTNO AND TB.AFFIRMOR_ID = HR_AFFIRMOR.PERSON_ID AND HR_AFFIRMOR.DUTY_NO = SG.NO(+) AND TB.AFFIRM_TYPE_ID = #APPLY_TYPE_NO:VARCHAR# AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND D.DEPTNO = (SELECT DEPTNO FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#) AND TB.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# ORDER BY AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT S.AFFIRMOR_ID, S.DUTY_NO, S.AFFIRM_LEVEL, S.REFERENCN_FROM_FLAG, S.REFERENCN_TO_FLAG, H.EMPID, H.LOCAL_NAME, N.CONTENT DUTY_NAME FROM (SELECT GET_AFFIRMER_BY_DUTY(#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, HTA.DUTY_NO, #DEPT_NO:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) AFFIRMOR_ID, HTA.DUTY_NO, HTA.AFFIRM_LEVEL, EL.REFERENCN_FROM_FLAG, EL.REFERENCN_TO_FLAG FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_AFFIRM_PARAM HTA, ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM EL WHERE HTA.APPLY_PARAM_NO = EL.APPLY_PARAM_NO AND EL.APPLY_TYPE = #APPLY_TYPE_CODE:VARCHAR# AND EL.DUTY_NO = #DUTY_NO:VARCHAR# AND EL.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND EL.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY AFFIRM_LEVEL) S, HR_EMPLOYEE H, SY_GLOBAL_NAME N WHERE S.AFFIRMOR_ID = H.PERSON_ID AND H.DUTY_NO = N.NO(+) AND N.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT * FROM (SELECT A.AFFIRM_LEVEL, T.DUTY_NO, GET_AFFIRMER_BY_DUTY(#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#,T.DUTY_NO,#DEPT_NO:VARCHAR#,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) AS AFFIRMOR_ID, SG.CONTENT DUTY_NAME, (SELECT H.EMPID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = GET_AFFIRMER_BY_DUTY(#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#,T.DUTY_NO,#DEPT_NO:VARCHAR#,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#)) AS AFFIRMOR_EMPID, (SELECT H.LOCAL_NAME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = GET_AFFIRMER_BY_DUTY(#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#,T.DUTY_NO,#DEPT_NO:VARCHAR#,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#)) AS AFFIRMOR_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.AFFIRM_LEVEL ORDER BY A.AFFIRM_LEVEL) AS RN FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM T, ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_AFFIRM_PARAM A, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE T.APPLY_PARAM_NO = A.APPLY_AFFIRM_PARAM_NO(+) AND T.DUTY_NO = SG.NO(+) AND T.APPLY_TYPE = #APPLY_TYPE_CODE:VARCHAR#) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY AFFIRM_LEVEL
sqlMap.insert:
INSERT INTO ESS_APPLY_OT (APPLY_NO, PERSON_ID, OT_TYPE_NO, OT_TYPE_CODE, APPLY_OT_DATE, APPLY_TYPE, OT_TIME_TYPE,
OT_FROM_TIME, OT_TO_TIME, OT_DEDUCT_TIME,
OT_APPLY_HOUR, OT_APPLY_MINUTE,
AFFIRM_FLAG, ADJUST_YN, APPLY_OT_REMARK,
CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, ACTIVITY, ORDERNO, CURRENT_AFFIRM_ID, BATCHNO ) VALUES ( #APPLY_NO_SEQ#, #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, #APPLY_TYPE_NO#, #APPLY_TYPE_CODE#, TO_DATE(#APPLY_OT_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #APPLY_TYPE:VARCHAR#, #OT_TIME_TYPE:VARCHAR#,
TO_DATE(#FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(#TO_TIME:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), to_number(nvl(#OT_DEDUCT_TIME#,0)),
#OT_APPLY_HOUR#, #OT_APPLY_MINUTE#,
#AFFIRM_FLAG#, #ADJUST_YN#, #APPLY_REMARK:VARCHAR#,
SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #ACTIVITY#, (SELECT NVL(MAX(ORDERNO),0) + 1 FROM ESS_APPLY_OT), #CURRENT_AFFIRM_ID:VARCHAR#, #BATCHNO:VARCHAR# )

CODE_NO IN (SELECT CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE_PARAM WHERE CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#)
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(get_global_name(CODE_NO, 'zh'))

SELECT get_ar_shift_start_time(#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, TO_CHAR(to_date(#FROM_DATE#, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) SHIFT_START_TIME, get_ar_shift_end_time(#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, TO_CHAR(to_date(#FROM_DATE#, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) SHIFT_END_TIME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(GET_AR_DATETYPE(#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, TO_CHAR(to_date(#FROM_DATE#, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#), #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) TYPE, GET_AR_DATETYPE(#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, TO_CHAR(to_date(#FROM_DATE#, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) CODE FROM DUAL

SELECT ESS.APPLY_NO, HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, get_global_name(HE.POSITION_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POSITION, get_global_name(HE.POST_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST, get_global_name(HE.DUTY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY, get_dept_name(HE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPT_NAME, get_global_name(ESS.OT_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) OT_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(ESS.APPLY_OT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') APPLY_OT_DATE FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, ESS_APPLY_OT ESS WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = ESS.PERSON_ID
ESS.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY ESS.APPLY_NO

SELECT ESS.APPLY_NO, ESS.APPLY_TYPE, ESS.ESS_AFFIRM_NO, HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, get_global_name(HE.POSITION_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POSITION, get_global_name(HE.POST_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST, get_global_name(HE.DUTY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY, get_dept_name(HE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPT_NAME, ESS.AFFIRM_LEVEL, ESS.AFFIRMOR_ID, ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG, ESS.AFFIRM_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(ESS.UPDATE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AFFIRM_DATE, ESS.CHECK_REASON, ESS.CHECKOR_ID, ESS.CHECK_FLAG, ESS.CHECK_CONTENT, ESS.CHECK_DATE, ESS.CHECK_CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(ESS.CHECK_CREATED_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') CHECK_CREATED_DATE FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, ESS_AFFIRM ESS WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = ESS.AFFIRMOR_ID
ESS.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#
ESS.APPLY_TYPE = #APPLY_TYPE_NO:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY ESS.AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT ESS.APPLY_NO, ESS.APPLY_TYPE, ESS.ESS_AFFIRM_NO, HE.EMPID AFFIRM_EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME AFFIRM_NAME, get_global_name(HE.POSITION_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AFFIRM_POSITION, get_global_name(HE.POST_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AFFIRM_POST, get_global_name(HE.DUTY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AFFIRM_DUTY, get_dept_name(HE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AFFIRM_DEPT_NAME, ESS.AFFIRM_LEVEL, ESS.AFFIRMOR_ID, ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG, ESS.AFFIRM_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(ESS.UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AFFIRM_DATE, ESS.CURRENT_CHECKOR_ID,
CHE.EMPID CHECK_EMPID, CHE.LOCAL_NAME CHECK_NAME, get_global_name(CHE.POSITION_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CHECK_POSITION, get_global_name(CHE.POST_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CHECK_POST, get_global_name(CHE.DUTY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CHECK_DUTY, get_dept_name(CHE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CHECK_DEPT_NAME, EC.ESS_CHECK_NO, EC.CHECK_REASON, EC.CHECK_LEVEL, EC.CHECK_FLAG, EC.CHECKOR_ID, EC.CHECK_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(EC.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') CHECK_CREATE_DATE, EC.CREATED_BY CHECK_CREATE_BY, TO_CHAR(EC.UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') CHECKED_DATE, EC.UPDATED_BY CHECKED_BY
FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, ESS_AFFIRM ESS, HR_EMPLOYEE CHE,ESS_CHECK EC WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = ESS.AFFIRMOR_ID AND ESS.ESS_AFFIRM_NO = EC.ESS_AFFIRM_NO AND EC.CHECKOR_ID = CHE.PERSON_ID
ESS.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY ESS.APPLY_NO,EC.CHECK_LEVEL
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT WHERE OT.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#
DELETE FROM ESS_AFFIRM OT WHERE OT.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#
DELETE FROM AR_APPLY_RESULT OT WHERE OT.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ESS_APPLY_OT OT SET AFFIRM_FLAG = 3, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #ADMIN_ID:VARCHAR# WHERE OT.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#

sql.isNotEmpty: EXISTS (SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #DEPT_NO# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
(EXISTS( SELECT * FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# ) OR H.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR#)
EXISTS (SELECT * FROM AR_EMP_GROUP E WHERE E.GROUP_NO = #GROUP_NO:VARCHAR# AND E.PERSON_ID = ADT.PERSON_ID)
EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO =#DEPT_NO:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
sql.isEmpty: EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in ( SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# ) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# UNION SELECT SUD.DEPTNO FROM SY_USER SU,SY_USER_DEPT SUD WHERE SU.USER_NO = SUD.USER_NO AND SU.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# AND SUD.DEPTNO=H.DEPTNO)

SELECT H.EMPID EMPID_ID, H.LOCAL_NAME, H.PERSON_ID PERSON_ID_ID, GET_DEPT_NAME(D.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_GRADE_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.MAIN_BUSINESS,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) MAIN_BUSINESS, H.HEAD_DEPARTMENT, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POSITION_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POSITION_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.EMP_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) EMP_TYPE_CODE, H.DATE_STARTED, (SELECT HED.INSTITUTION_NAME FROM HR_EDUCATION HED WHERE HED.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID
AND ROWNUM = 1) INSTITUTION_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.WORK_AREA,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) WORK_AREA, H.INCUMBENCY, HR.PHOTO_PATH, get_local_name_personid (CASE WHEN D.MANAGER_EMP_ID = H.PERSON_ID THEN (SELECT HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.DEPTNO=D.PARENT_DEPT_NO)ELSE D.MANAGER_EMP_ID END ,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) MANAGER_NAME
FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H, HR_PERSONAL_INFO HR, HR_DEPARTMENT D
WHERE H.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO AND HR.PERSON_ID(+)=H.PERSON_ID AND H.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID# AND H.ACTIVITY=1
EXISTS (SELECT * FROM AR_EMP_GROUP E WHERE E.GROUP_NO = #GROUP_NO:VARCHAR# AND E.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID)

SELECT COUNT(0) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H, HR_DEPARTMENT D WHERE H.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO
AND H.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID#
EXISTS (SELECT * FROM AR_EMP_GROUP E WHERE E.GROUP_NO = #GROUP_NO:VARCHAR# AND E.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID)

SELECT H.EMPID EMPID_ID, H.LOCAL_NAME, get_global_name(H.POST_FAMILY, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_FAMILY, get_global_name(H.DUTY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY_NO, get_global_name(H.POSITION, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POSITION, get_global_name(H.COST_CENTER, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) COST_CENTER, get_global_name(HR.NATIONALITY_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) NATIONALITY_CODE, GET_DEPT_MANAGER_INFO(H.DEPTNO) HEAD_DEPARTMENT, PKG_DECRYPT.DECRYPT_DES(HR.CELLPHONE) CELLPHONE, PKG_DECRYPT.DECRYPT_DES(HR.OFFICE_PHONE)OFFICE_PHONE, H.PERSON_ID PERSON_ID_ID, D.ORG_NAME_LOCAL, GET_DEPT_NAME(D.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_GRADE_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.MAIN_BUSINESS,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) MAIN_BUSINESS, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POSITION_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POSITION_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.EMP_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) EMP_TYPE_CODE, TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED,'DD/MM/YYYY') DATE_STARTED, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,H.DATE_STARTED)/12) WORK_AGE, TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,H.DATE_STARTED),12)) WORK_AGE_MONTH, EXTRACT(DAY FROM(numtodsinterval(SYSDATE-(add_months(H.DATE_STARTED,trunc(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, H.DATE_STARTED)))),'day'))) WORK_AGE_DAY, GET_GLOBAL_NAME((SELECT MAX(HE.DEGREE_CODE) FROM HR_EDUCATION HE WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID), #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEGREE_CODE, (SELECT MAX(HE.INSTITUTION_NAME) FROM HR_EDUCATION HE WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID AND HE.DEGREE_CODE = (SELECT MAX(HE1.DEGREE_CODE) FROM HR_EDUCATION HE1 WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = HE1.PERSON_ID)) INSTITUTION_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.WORK_AREA,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) WORK_AREA, H.INCUMBENCY, HR.PHOTO_PATH, get_local_name_personid (CASE WHEN D.MANAGER_EMP_ID = H.PERSON_ID THEN (SELECT HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.DEPTNO=D.PARENT_DEPT_NO)ELSE D.MANAGER_EMP_ID END ,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) MANAGER_NAME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H, HR_PERSONAL_INFO HR, HR_DEPARTMENT D, SY_CODE SC WHERE H.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO(+) AND HR.PERSON_ID(+)=H.PERSON_ID AND H.POST_GRADE_NO = SC.CODE_NO(+) AND H.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND H.ACTIVITY=1 AND H.EMPID NOT LIKE '111111%'
EXISTS (SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #DEPT_NO# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# )
(H.EMPID LIKE #seach_KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR H.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #seach_KEY:VARCHAR# || '%')
H.EMP_TYPE_CODE=#EMP_TYPE_CODE#
H.EMP_OFFICE=#EMP_OFFICE#
HR.NATIONALITY_CODE=#NATIONALITY_CODE#
TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED,'YYYY.MM.DD') >= #DATE_FROM_STARTED#
TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED,'YYYY.MM.DD') <= #DATE_TO_STARTED#
TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED,'YYYY.MM.DD') BETWEEN #DATE_FROM_STARTED# AND #DATE_TO_STARTED#
HR.SEXCODE=#SEXCODE#
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 19
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 20 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 24
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 25 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 29
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 30 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 34
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 35 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 39
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 40 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 44
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 45 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 49
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 50
HR.NATION_CODE=#NATION_CODE#
ORDER BY HR.NATIONALITY_CODE,H.EMPID ASC

EXISTS (SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #DEPT_NO# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# )
(H.EMPID LIKE #seach_KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR H.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #seach_KEY:VARCHAR# || '%')
H.EMP_TYPE_CODE=#EMP_TYPE_CODE#
H.EMP_OFFICE=#EMP_OFFICE#
TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED,'YYYY.MM.DD') >= #DATE_FROM_STARTED#
TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED,'YYYY.MM.DD') <= #DATE_TO_STARTED#
TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED,'YYYY.MM.DD') BETWEEN #DATE_FROM_STARTED# AND #DATE_TO_STARTED#
HR.SEXCODE=#SEXCODE#
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 19
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 20 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 24
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 25 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 29
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 30 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 34
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 35 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 39
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 40 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 44
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 45 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') <= 49
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(HR.DOB, 'YYYY') > 50
HR.NATION_CODE=#NATION_CODE#
ORDER BY H.DEPTNO,SC.ORDERNO,H.EMPID

SELECT TB.AFFIRMOR_ID, TB.AFFIRM_LEVEL, HR_AFFIRMOR.EMPID, HR_AFFIRMOR.CHINESE_PINYIN, HR_AFFIRMOR.LOCAL_NAME, SG.CONTENT POSITIONNAME FROM SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_TB TB, HR_EMPLOYEE HRE, HR_EMPLOYEE HR_AFFIRMOR, HR_POSITION HPO, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE HRE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID# AND HR_AFFIRMOR.POSITION_NO = HPO.POSITION_NO(+) AND HPO.POSITION_NO = SG.NO(+) AND TB.AFFIRMOR_ID = HR_AFFIRMOR.PERSON_ID AND TB.AFFIRM_TYPE_ID = #APPLY_TYPE_NO# AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_TB.AFFIRM_OBJECT = HR_EMPLOYEE.EMPID
SY_AFFIRM_RELATION_TB.AFFIRM_OBJECT = HR_EMPLOYEE.DEPTID
ORDER BY AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT HR_EMPLOYEE.LOCAL_NAME, HR_EMPLOYEE.CHINESE_PINYIN, HR_EMPLOYEE.EMPID, AR_SHIFT010.SHIFT_NO, SG.CONTENT SHIFT_NAME, #CREATE_DATE# SHIFT_TIME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#CREATE_DATE# || TO_CHAR(AR_SHIFT020.FROM_TIME, ' HH24:MI'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') + AR_SHIFT020.BEGIN_DAY_OFFSET, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#CREATE_DATE# || TO_CHAR(AR_SHIFT020.TO_TIME, ' HH24:MI'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') + AR_SHIFT020.END_DAY_OFFSET, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') TO_TIME FROM AR_SHIFT020, AR_SHIFT010, HR_EMPLOYEE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE AR_SHIFT010.SHIFT_NO = AR_SHIFT020.SHIFT_NO AND SG.NO = AR_SHIFT020.SHIFT_NO AND AR_SHIFT010.SHIFT_NO = GET_AR_SHIFTNO(#PERSON_ID#,replace(#CREATE_DATE#, '-', '/'), #CPNY_ID#) AND HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID# AND SG.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#

SELECT T.TOT_VAC_CNT - (SELECT NVL(SUM(A.QUANTITY), 0) FROM $AR_DETAIL$ A WHERE A.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID AND A.ITEM_NO = '16395' AND A.AR_DATE_STR BETWEEN TO_CHAR(T.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND TO_CHAR(T.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) FROM AR_VAC_EMP T WHERE T.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND VAC_TP = '26' AND TO_DATE(#LEAVE_FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN T.STRT_DATE AND T.END_DATE AND ACTIVITY = 1

SELECT T.TOT_VAC_CNT/8 TOTALANNUALLEAVE, (T.TOT_VAC_CNT - (SELECT NVL(SUM(A.QUANTITY), 0) FROM $AR_DETAIL$ A WHERE A.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID AND A.ITEM_NO in ('16395','124831','124832') AND A.AR_DATE_STR BETWEEN TO_CHAR(T.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND TO_CHAR(T.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD')))/8 RESTANNUALLEAVE, (SELECT NVL(SUM(A.QUANTITY), 0) FROM $AR_DETAIL$ A WHERE A.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID AND A.ITEM_NO in ('16395','124831','124832') AND A.AR_DATE_STR BETWEEN TO_CHAR(T.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND TO_CHAR(T.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'))/8 USEANNUALLEAVE, (SELECT NVL(SUM(A.QUANTITY), 0) FROM $AR_DETAIL$ A WHERE A.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID AND A.ITEM_NO in ('16395','124831','124832') AND A.AR_DATE_STR BETWEEN to_char(to_date(to_char(sysdate,'YYYY/MM')||'/01','YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYY/MM/DD'))/8 INSTANTUSEANNUALLEAVE FROM AR_VAC_EMP T WHERE T.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND VAC_TP = '26' AND TO_DATE(#LEAVE_FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN T.STRT_DATE AND T.END_DATE AND ACTIVITY = 1

SELECT T.TOT_VAC_CNT - (SELECT NVL(SUM(A.QUANTITY), 0) FROM $AR_DETAIL$ A WHERE A.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID AND A.ITEM_NO = '16395' AND A.AR_DATE_STR BETWEEN TO_CHAR(T.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND TO_CHAR(T.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) FROM AR_VAC_EMP T WHERE T.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND VAC_TP = '26' AND ADD_MONTHS(to_date(#LEAVE_FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#,'YYYY-MM-DD'),-12) BETWEEN T.STRT_DATE AND T.END_DATE AND ACTIVITY = 1

SELECT to_char(AAR.YEAR_TOTAL - AAR.YEAR_USE_TOTAL - (SELECT NVL(SUM(A.QUANTITY), 0) FROM $AR_DETAIL$ A WHERE A.PERSON_ID = AAR.PERSON_ID AND A.ITEM_NO = '18134' AND A.AR_DATE_STR BETWEEN TO_CHAR(GET_AR_START_DATE(#YEAR_NONTH:VARCHAR#,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, GET_AR_STATNO(HE.PERSON_ID,HE.CPNY_ID)), 'yyyy/mm/dd') AND TO_CHAR(GET_AR_END_DATE(#YEAR_NONTH:VARCHAR#,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, GET_AR_STATNO(HE.PERSON_ID,HE.CPNY_ID)), 'yyyy/mm/dd'))) FROM AR_ADJUST_REST AAR, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE AAR.PERSON_ID = HE.PERSON_ID AND AAR.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND AAR.YEAR = #YEAR:VARCHAR#

SELECT GET_ADJUST_REST(#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#) FROM DUAL

SELECT nvl(GET_AR_DATETYPE(#PERSON_ID#, #APPLY_DATE_STR#, #CPNY_ID#),0) FROM DUAL

SELECT NVL(SUM(A.TOT_VAC_CNT - (SELECT NVL(SUM(T.QUANTITY), 0) FROM $AR_DETAIL$ T WHERE T.PERSON_ID = A.PERSON_ID AND T.ITEM_NO in ('16395','124831','124832') AND T.AR_DATE_STR BETWEEN TO_CHAR(A.STRT_DATE, 'yyyy/mm/dd') AND TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'yyyy/mm/dd'))), 0) REST_VAC_CNT FROM AR_VAC_EMP A WHERE A.ACTIVITY = 1 AND A.VAC_TP = '26' AND A.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID#
SYSDATE BETWEEN A.STRT_DATE AND A.END_DATE
TO_DATE(#checkDate#, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') BETWEEN A.STRT_DATE AND A.END_DATE + 1

EA.CURRENT_AFFIRM_ID = #ADMIN_ID#

EA.APPLY_TIME <= TO_DATE(#END_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
(H.EMPID LIKE UPPER('%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%') OR H.LOCAL_NAME LIKE UPPER('%' || #KEY:VARCHARV# || '%') OR UPPER(H.CHINESE_PINYIN) LIKE UPPER('%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%') OR H.ENGLISH_NAME LIKE UPPER('%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%'))

EXISTS (SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #DEPT_NO# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO)

HEH.EMP_TYPE_CODE IN ( $EMP_TYPE_CODE$)
HEH.EMP_OFFICE = #STATUS_CODE#

GROUP BY
ORDER BY

T_SCHEDULE.DATATYPE, SY1.CONTENT TYPENAME, SY2.CONTENT SHIFT_NAME, SY3.CONTENT DATETYPENAME, (CASE WHEN INSTR(SY2.CONTENT, '休息') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) ISXIUXI FROM AR_CALENDER, (SELECT T1.SHIFT_NO SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NO, T1.AR_DATE_STR, T2.DATATYPE FROM AR_SCHEDULE_$CPNY_ID$ T1, AR_SHIFT010 T2 WHERE T1.SHIFT_NO = T2.SHIFT_NO AND T1.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#) T_SCHEDULE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3 WHERE AR_CALENDER.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND AR_CALENDER.DDATE = to_date(T_SCHEDULE.AR_DATE_STR(+),'yyyy-mm-dd') AND AR_CALENDER.DDATE BETWEEN GET_AR_START_DATE(#AR_MONTH:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#,#STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) AND GET_AR_END_DATE(#AR_MONTH:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#,#STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) AND AR_CALENDER.TYPEID = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND AR_CALENDER.SHIFT_NO = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T_SCHEDULE.DATATYPE = SY3.NO(+) AND SY3.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# ORDER BY AR_CALENDER.DDATE

SELECT DDATE, IYEAR, IMONTH, IDAY, IWEEK, WORKDAYFLAG, C.TYPEID, S1.CONTENT DATETYPENAME, OVERTYPEID, TYPEID_DEFAULT, C.SHIFT_NO, S2.CONTENT SHIFT_NAME, C.AR_DATE_STR DDATE_STR, TO_CHAR(DDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') MODFIY_DATE_STR, #interLanguage:VARCHAR# LANGUAGE, C.SHIFT_NO SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NO FROM AR_CALENDER_GROUP C, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S2 WHERE C.TYPEID = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND C.SHIFT_NO = S2.NO(+) AND S2.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND C.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND C.DDATE BETWEEN GET_AR_FIRST_DATE(#AR_MONTH:VARCHAR#,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#,'') AND GET_AR_LAST_DATE(#AR_MONTH:VARCHAR#,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#,'') AND C.GROUP_ID=#GROUP_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY IYEAR, IMONTH, IDAY

SELECT AR_CALENDER_GROUP.DDATE, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.IYEAR, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.IMONTH, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.IDAY, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.IWEEK, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.TYPEID, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.OVERTYPEID, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.WORKDAYFLAG, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.SHIFT_NO AS SHIFT_NO, AR_CALENDER_GROUP.TYPEID_DEFAULT FROM AR_CALENDER AR_CALENDER_GROUP WHERE AR_CALENDER_GROUP.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND AR_CALENDER_GROUP.DDATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#AR_MONTH:VARCHAR#,'YYYY-MM'),-1)+19 AND TO_DATE(#AR_MONTH:VARCHAR#||'19','YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY AR_CALENDER_GROUP.DDATE

SELECT 1,
BIRTH, COUNT(NVL(HEH.POST_GRADE_NO,'0')) COUNTNUM FROM ( SELECT HS.PERSON_ID, HS.DATE_STR AR_DATE_STR, HS.POST_GRADE_NO, HS.DEPTNO DEPT_NO FROM HR_EMP_HISTORY_STATUS HS WHERE HS.DATE_STR = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#YEARMONTHDAY#, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') GROUP BY HS.PERSON_ID, HS.DATE_STR, HS.POST_GRADE_NO, HS.DEPTNO ) ADT, ORG_INFO OI,HR_EMPLOYEE HEH WHERE HEH.PERSON_ID(+)=ADT.PERSON_ID AND HEH.EMP_OFFICE = '15119' AND HEH.PERSON_ID not like '111111%' AND ADT.PERSON_ID not like '111111%' AND OI.RESUME_NO = pkg_resume_process.GET_HISTORY_RESUME_NO(#interCpnyID#, #YEARMONTHDAY#) AND OI.ACTIVITY='1' AND OI.DEPTNO = ADT.DEPT_NO
OI.DEPTNO IN (SELECT HD2.DEPTNO FROM ( SELECT HD2.DEPTNO,HD2.PARENT_DEPT_NO FROM ORG_INFO HD2 WHERE HD2.RESUME_NO = PKG_RESUME_PROCESS.GET_HISTORY_RESUME_NO(#interCpnyID#, #YEARMONTHDAY#) AND HD2.ACTIVITY = '1') HD2 START WITH HD2.DEPTNO = #PARENT_DEPT_NO# CONNECT BY PRIOR HD2.DEPTNO = HD2.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
HEH.EMP_TYPE_CODE IN ( $EMP_TYPE_CODE$)
HEH.STATUS_CODE = #STATUS_CODE#
(EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = ADT.DEPT_NO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = ADT.DEPT_NO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO#) )
GROUP BY
ORDER BY

SELECT 1,

SELECT T.MENU_CODE, S.CONTENT AS MENU_NAME, T.MENU_URL, T.DEPTH, T.MENU_NO FROM SY_MENU T, SY_MENU_PARAM T2,SY_GLOBAL_NAME S WHERE T.ACTIVITY = 1 AND T2.ACTIVITY = 1 AND T.MENU_NO = S.NO(+) AND S.LANGUAGE(+) = #language:VARCHAR# AND T.MENU_NO = T2.MENU_NO AND T2.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND T.MENU_PARENT_NO = '2539' AND T.MENU_CODE NOT IN ('hr1100','hr2100','hr2101','pa0714') START WITH T.MENU_PARENT_NO = 0 and T2.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND S.LANGUAGE(+)=#interLanguage:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR T.MENU_NO = T.MENU_PARENT_NO and T2.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND S.LANGUAGE(+)=#interLanguage:VARCHAR# ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.ORDERNO
